does: Rolls every roll request created since the last frame: walks the eoc::RequestedRollComponent entities just added and calls esv::RollSystem::RollDice on each that is not waiting for the player; the frame every roll of the roll system (concentration, dialogue window, story passive check) passes.

evidence.says: a query with the added tag over a component of 0x1F0 bytes (eoc::RequestedRollComponent), then code:esv::RollSystem::RollDice per entity; called from code:esv::RollSystem::Update between the processing of concentration damage rolls and of roll call requests
the chains of a concentration save, a story passive Perception check and the first roll of a dialogue check pass it; the RequestedRoll created each time is read in the same tick
A count-only probe on code:esv::RollSystem::RollDice names this function as its caller

questions.ask: Whether this body is the Toolkit's ProcessCreateEvents and not one of its siblings (ProcessNewRollsAdded, ProcessRequestedRollComponents): compare it with the export's body in EoCServer.dll.
